item.title: As millions of kids lose SNAP food benefits, free school meals are also at risk
item.description: Food stamps have a direct link to other critical resources, such as free breakfast and lunch at school. Now, experts say they're starting to see that link break.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Trump administration mulls renaming USS Doris Miller
item.description: The Trump administration is considering stripping the name of an African American war hero from an aircraft carrier, even though President Trump himself praised the honor in his first term.

item.title: Jury is deadlocked in Lindsay Clancy's trial
item.description: Jurors in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts woman charged with murdering her three children, are deadlocked after five days of deliberation.

item.title: Former top military leader on dismissals in the Pentagon under Secretary Hegseth
item.description: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with retired 4-star General Peter Chiarelli {ker-ELL-ee} about Pentagon leadership and the departure of top officials.

item.title: Ex-military officials raise alarm over leadership departures from the Pentagon
item.description: Former U.S. military officials are raising alarms about the exodus of experienced leaders from the Pentagon, against the backdrop of the conflict with Iran and concerns over depleted stockpiles.

item.title: New immigration court tactic leads to huge lines and chaos in Miami
item.description: Chaos unfolds at the Miami immigration court after judges are assigned mega master calendars, hearings where judges see more than 100 immigrants at once.

item.title: Understanding the tech giants' oversized influence in American schools
item.description: Big tech companies like Apple and Microsoft use devices, training and conferences for teachers and students to embed in schools. The New York Times' Natasha Singer discusses the impact in Coding Kids.

item.title: New lawsuits claim OpenAI execs put image ahead of safety in Canadian mass shooting
item.description: The suits say that recommendations to alert police about the alleged shooter were nixed by OpenAI's global affairs team, led by veteran political strategist Chris Lehane. OpenAI denies the claims.

item.title: How will tariffs affect the midterms? In this Michigan border town, it's complicated
item.description: The recent trade war between the U.S. and Canada has both economic and political implications for Michigan, given it's the state's top trade partner.

item.title: ICE detainee dies just hours after he was admitted into detention
item.description: Lianyong Wei's death marks the 57th death of an immigrant detainee held in the care of the government since the start of President Trump's second term. Twenty-four of those have occurred since Jan. 1.
